note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after c85342c940). Section 4.6.1.1 LSP_TUNNEL_IPv4 Session Object diagram: the 16 bits before Tunnel ID are "MUST be zero". TestRSVPSessionObjectEncoding changed only by the deleted RFC3209-4.6.1-2 tag line; its body is identical and still encodes into a zeroed buffer, so alone it would not discriminate a skipped write. TestRFC3209SessionReservedZeroOverDirtyBuffer carries the verdict: it prefills 0xFF and asserts buf[8:10] zero, the header 0,16,1,7, the endpoint and Tunnel ID, so encodeSessionIPv4 (internal/plugins/rsvpte/wire.go) dropping buf[8]=0, buf[9]=0 goes red. Single polarity as annotated: no decoder reads the field.
